title: AE51004: Aircraft Fuel System
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE31001
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsFuel performance in
engines; combustion efficiency: effects of altitude, fuel volatility, injection
and molecular structures of fuel on combustion efficiency; Altitude operational
limits; Carbon deposits, smoking, Starting performance, ignition
characteristics; Fuel behavior in aircraft fuel systems, fuel specification and
availability, potential low cost fuels, residual fuels for gas turbine
applications.
